question: What kind of beauty is attained that is entirely devoid of marks?
premises: Something has departed or attained entirely
It reaches an indescribable good beauty
That beauty is devoid of marks
inference: An indescribable, markless beauty is fully attained
uncertainties: suṣamām may refer to beauty or evenness/radiance
plain_english: It has entirely attained a certain indescribable beauty, devoid of any mark.
